title: Review Booking Requests (Venue Staff approve and reject)
note: Primary scope: backend venue service, controller and repository specs for the SPM-55 review endpoints, and the frontend BookingsPage and format specs. Six PostgreSQL HTTP/E2E tests cover the approve/reject happy paths (VEN-REV-10-A, VEN-REV-10-B), migration 022 backfill isolation (VEN-REV-11-A), the stored booking slot after an event schedule change (VEN-REV-12-A) and per-attempt special requests after a reject and resubmit (VEN-REV-12-B, VEN-REV-12-C, in the Venue Staff list and My Bookings); VEN-REV-12-A to 12-C answer PR #78 review findings SPM55-REVIEW-002 and -003 and kill VEN-REV-M46 to M52; VEN-REV-M53 to M55 back the kills claimed by VEN-REV-10-A, 10-B and 11-A. The backend-spm55 mutation runner needs no DATABASE_URL as a whole: only its reviewE2e suite does (needsEnv in spm55.mutants.mjs), so without PostgreSQL the 34 unit-level mutants still run and the 10 E2E mutants are reported as skipped. Browser automation is not in scope. The SPM-55 Confluence matrix was not verified from this session, so the VEN-REV ids are registered as SUPPORTING with owner approval pending.
